title: View toll charges on an E-Toll account
summary: View your toll charges and statement online using your E-Toll account.
intro:
If you have a Transport for NSW E-Toll account, you can view your toll charges online.

Log in to your E-Toll account to view your toll charges and statement.

You can choose to have your statement issued monthly, quarterly or yearly.
who_can_apply: Having a Transport for NSW E-Toll account

how_to_steps.text: You’ll receive an email to let you know your statement is ready to view/download. To find your E-Toll statement online, log in to your account and select 'Statements/invoices'.
If you want to receive your statement by post, you’ll be charged a fee.
Eligible pensioners and war widows can receive statements by post for free.
You can switch to electronic statements at any time by logging in to your account.
Note: You may not be able to view a complete list of toll charges as it may take up to 7 days for all charges to be received from toll road operators.

faqs.q: How can I view my toll charges?
faqs.a: Log in to your E-Toll account to view your toll charges and statement.

faqs.q: How do I receive my statement?
faqs.a: You can choose to have your statement issued monthly, quarterly, or yearly. You can also view it online by logging in and selecting 'Statements/invoices'.

faqs.q: Is there a fee for receiving a statement by post?
faqs.a: Yes, if you want to receive your statement by post, you will be charged a fee. However, eligible pensioners and war widows can receive statements by post for free.
